submission.justification: K1 has the best resolution (2.9%) but its measured intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is four times the 0.5 budget, so it is excluded. K2 meets the budget at 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day and has the better resolution of the two remaining crystals (4.5% against 8.5% for K3). I chose 5 cm because the 2025 simulation was run at that thickness and found weak thickness dependence from 3 to 8 cm. I did not run a new thickness scan, so the 4.5% figure is the 2025 value at 5 cm.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K2 gives 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm. This is the best of the crystals that satisfy the background limit. K1 is better at 2.9% but is excluded.
K2 measured 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day in the Q1 2026 assay. K1 measured 2.0 and fails.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
